story.paragraph: A woman sits in a room with a laptop and talks. A man in a suit sits holding a teacup. The woman gestures while talking at her desk. The man in the suit is then seen sitting in another room with a large window, while a bald man stands by the window looking out at the sea. The woman continues to talk at her desk. The bald man turns to look back into the room. The woman looks up and continues talking. The bald man continues to look back into the room.
story.summary: A woman talks at her desk while a man in a suit sits with a teacup and a bald man stands by a window looking out at the sea.
